title: log-step-duration-warning
request: Can we add a configurable warning when a step takes longer than a threshold? I'd like Monitor to accept a warning_threshold and have AgentLogger log a warning when a step duration exceeds it.

--- a/src/smolagents/monitoring.py
+++ b/src/smolagents/monitoring.py
@@ -79,10 +79,11 @@
 
 
 class Monitor:
-    def __init__(self, tracked_model, logger):
+    def __init__(self, tracked_model, logger, warning_threshold: float | None = None):
         self.step_durations = []
         self.tracked_model = tracked_model
         self.logger = logger
+        self.warning_threshold = warning_threshold
         self.total_input_token_count = 0
         self.total_output_token_count = 0
 
@@ -106,6 +107,11 @@
         step_duration = step_log.timing.duration
         self.step_durations.append(step_duration)
         console_outputs = f"[Step {len(self.step_durations)}: Duration {step_duration:.2f} seconds"
+        # Warn if duration exceeds the configured threshold
+        if getattr(self, "warning_threshold", None) is not None and step_duration > self.warning_threshold:
+            self.logger.log_warning(
+                f"Step {len(self.step_durations)} duration {step_duration:.2f}s exceeds threshold {self.warning_threshold}s"
+            )
 
         if step_log.token_usage is not None:
             self.total_input_token_count += step_log.token_usage.input_tokens

--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_monitoring_warning.py
@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+import pytest
+from rich.console import Console
+from smolagents.monitoring import Monitor, AgentLogger, LogLevel
+
+class DummyTiming:
+    def __init__(self, duration):
+        self.start_time = 0
+        self.end_time = duration
+
+    @property
+    def duration(self):
+        return self.end_time - self.start_time
+
+class DummyStepLog:
+    def __init__(self, duration):
+        self.timing = DummyTiming(duration)
+        self.token_usage = None
+
+def test_monitor_warns_on_long_step():
+    console = Console(record=True)
+    logger = AgentLogger(level=LogLevel.INFO, console=console)
+    monitor = Monitor(tracked_model=None, logger=logger, warning_threshold=0.0)
+    # Step duration 1.23 seconds exceeds threshold 0.0
+    monitor.update_metrics(DummyStepLog(duration=1.23))
+    output = console.export_text()
+    assert "exceeds threshold" in output
+    assert "Step 1 duration 1.23s" in output
